act_title: The Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University Act, 2014
title: Any member, other than an _ex officio member of the Board, Academic Council or any other
text:
33. Any member, other than an _ex officio member of the Board, Academic Council or any other_

authority of the University or any committee of such authority may resign by letter addressed to the
Registrar and the resignation shall take effect as soon as such letter is received by the Registrar.

_Disqualifications_
